dag.description: XGBoost complete end-to-end pipeline for a tabular DNR/contact-risk model (e.g. cap_na, covering CA/MX/BR). A single calibration-split inference fans out to (a) ModelMetricsComputation -> ModelWikiGenerator for a published model wiki and (b) ModelCalibration (sigmoid/isotonic) that feeds Package -> Registration. No separate held-out testing branch.

agent_context.when_to_use: XGBoost tabular classifier (e.g. cap_na DNR contact-risk model for CA/MX/BR) that needs BOTH a published model wiki (metrics + plots) AND sigmoid/isotonic score calibration before packaging. One inference on the calibration split feeds both the metrics/wiki branch and the calibration branch.
agent_context.when_not_to_use: If you calibrate with percentile bucketing instead of ModelCalibration (use xgboost_complete_e2e_with_wiki_and_percentile_calibration). If you do not need a model wiki (use xgboost_complete_e2e). If metrics go to PIPER instead of a wiki (use xgboost_complete_e2e_with_piper_and_model_calibration).
differentiators: Single XGBoostModelInference_calibration forks to metrics/wiki AND ModelCalibration - no redundant second inference node (unlike xgboost_complete_e2e_with_wiki)
Emits a ModelWikiGenerator wiki from calibration-split metrics

prerequisites.check: Training + calibration Cradle SQL / dataset splits
prerequisites.how: two Cradle SQL blocks (or two job_type splits)
ModelMetricsComputation and ModelCalibration both require labels on the calibration split

common_pitfalls: ModelWikiGenerator consumes ModelMetricsComputation output, not raw inference
Package registers the ModelCalibration output, not raw XGBoostTraining
Both branches share the one XGBoostModelInference_calibration - do not duplicate the inference step
